content.text:
The Pale Harvest quest is complete. I killed the drowned captain and sailor on the wreck, took the key, and opened the strongbox to find a Kothringi Keystone. Nesh-Deeka paid me 100 gold for it, which brings me to about 550.

She doesn't recognise the carving herself, but says it's Kothringi make. She sent me to the Chime-Keepers' elder at Toklea in the Tulmek Washes, who should know more. She also said the Unbound have not found the wreck, and when I started to ask how she knew, she only said "we listen".

I still don't know what the keystone opens or where the Root is. Seal paste, Cuts-the-Old-Knot, Xeech-Leel and Umbriel are also unexplained. I've given the game my final notes, and it has ended.
